import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1);
    static final double EPS = 1e-8;
    static final int INF = (int) 2e9;
    static final long LINF = (long) 2e18;
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MAXN = (int) 3e6 + 10;

    static int p, k, t;
    static boolean[] used = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void dfs(int x) {
        used[x] = true;
        int to = (int)(((long) x * k) % p);
        if (!used[to]) {
            dfs(to);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        p = scanner.nextInt();
        k = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!used[i]) {
                t++;
                dfs(i);
            }
        }
        long ans = 1;
        int limit = t + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < limit; i++) {
            ans *= p;
            ans %= MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
